response.original_title: [Escalate-Guide] Princess Cruises Dispute Number: Customer Service, Refunds & Resolution Guide
response.overview: You can contact Princess Cruises customer support and dispute resolution directly at 1-866-254-7549 for US sales and support. Princess Cruises Contact Details US Customer Service & Dispute Help: 1-866-254-7549 (Monday–Friday 9 a.m. – 10 p.m. ET, Weekends 11 a.m. – 8 p.m. ET) Customer Relations Email: customerrelations@princesscruises.com Alternative Dispute Resolution (UK/ABTA): If you booked through the UK and have an unresolved dispute, Princess Cruises is a member of ABTA (membership No. V8764) which provides an approved Alternative Dispute Resolution process. General UK support is available at 0120 420 8151.
